summary: Shen Feizhi attends a dinner with Lan Luozhi, a 100% pheromone-matched Omega, arranged by their families. Throughout the meal, Gu Suizhou bombards Shen with jealous text messages. After the meal, Shen declines to exchange contact info with Lan, citing his partner's jealousy. Gu Suizhou arrives at the scene, visibly agitated and acting possessive. Shen dismisses his friend Leapton and leaves with Gu Suizhou in his sports car.
